about: The shell host protocol's messages (plan-modular-packages r4 addendum A1.4): each name the shell module may pass to hostCall, with the SHELL_HOST_LEVEL that introduced it. Append-only: a new message, or a compatible widening of one (a new optional field), adds a row at the next level; removing or narrowing one needs a new major and is refused in review unless planned. SHELL_HOST_LEVEL (web/shell/loader.ts) is the highest level here; scripts/optional-packages.mjs computes each js package's host_req from it.
